text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Today's the day of the big showdown...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Training's all done, so all that's left
is headin' back to the lodge, grabbin' my wallet, and then... and then...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna ask Trainer! On a, a... a d-date...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...To the festival, here I come!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Good work today!!

Yukino Bijin stood firmly before me with absolute resolve.
Just as I was being overwhelmed by her sheer intensity—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um! ...You see!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Inhaaaale... exhaaaale...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Deep breeeeath in... deep breeeeath out...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...All right!! Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: W-Would ya... would ya please!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Go to the festival with me?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Gaaah... I did it!! I asked! I really went and
asked 'em, honest to goodness...! On a date!!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Now I can die happy... Wait, no, hold on, Yukino!
It ain't a real date until they say yes, right?!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Thank ya so kindly!!
Yay, yaaay...!!

Yukino Bijin looked so ecstatic she seemed
ready to burst into dance right then and there.

With how tense she was, I wondered what had happened,
but seeing how much she wanted to go, I happily agreed.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Aww, shoot! Missed again!
Ring toss is way harder than it looks...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Sigh... I thought even if I ain't a "city girl" yet,
I could still look cool at a festival...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(I guess I've still got a long ways to go...
...A real long ways to go.)
choice_data_list: You still have rings left! You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(...Whenever Trainer smiles and cheers me on,
it just makes me feel so happy inside...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Right! I'm definitely landin' the next one!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(My heart feels all warm and fuzzy, and I perk right back up...
...Is it really okay for me to stay like this, though?)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (Even though I'm still nowhere near a real "city girl"...?)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(...I don't know for sure, but I gotta say thanks. For now,
I'll have a blast and make sure Trainer smiles too!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (If I'm mopin' around, everyone else gets down too—...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...A real "city girl"...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Doesn't just follow trends. She's always pretty, strong,
and pushes through anything with a smile—)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (That's what she's really like... ain't she...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Let's head over there next!
Let's have a candy-carving showdown~!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Just gotta do what I can, one step at a time.

With Yukino Bijin smiling cheerfully,
we made the absolute most of every festival stall.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Phew~ That was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I met ya, Trainer,
every single day has been so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Before you became my trainer and even now,
you've taught me so much. I'm truly grateful!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
So I wanted to thank you properly... and show you
how much I've grown thanks to your help, but...

...Looking back on things, I realized that this was
what she had been trying to find the words to say all along.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... I never seem to get it quite right.
Ah, but today I managed to ask you out properly!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I'm still nowhere close to a "city girl"...
and I haven't grown much either, but still...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so very much, truly!
I'll be countin' on ya from here on out, too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: —Phew. Heheh, I finally said it!

I couldn't hide my surprise at having been asked on a date,
but for now, I wanted to acknowledge all of Yukino Bijin's hard work.
choice_data_list: I always see how much you're growing.
I can always feel your growth, you know.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

Even if it's different from the "city girl" she strives to be,
I can clearly feel Yukino Bijin's growth as she keeps moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank ya kindly...
He-Heheh. You're so kind, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I still don't have much confidence, but...
One of these days, I wanna be able to say I've changed—

Yukino Bijin wants to take a step toward becoming a "city girl,"
and needs the confidence to do so. If that's the case—
choice_data_list: They were advertising that lipstick again, you know.
They were advertising that lipstick from before again.

text_block_list.text:
It was the lipstick Gold City had been advertising,
which we spotted when we were out together before.

Back then, Yukino Bijin held back, saying
"it's too soon for someone like me," but—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...I-I wanna go buy it!
Trainer, will you help me pick one out?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe! I can't wait!
I wanna find a shade... that really suits me!!

Whether that lipstick would be proof of her growth, nobody could say,
but it was undeniably an important first step for Yukino Bijin.
